lines.en: Another sunny morning, another reason to pull the curtain closed.
That sort of mantra had become commonplace for Wakana Watabe. But today, she’d chant it to herself from behind the desk of a friend rather than her own.
The reason for this was complicated as a feeling, but quite simple as a concept once pressed into the 2.54cm horizontal margins of a notebook.
The last room carried memories of her. Memories of midday trysts and scattered personal effects stored for later use or consumption.
It was never meant to be that way. Wakana Watabe cared deeply about her career, contrary to popular belief.
But she cared deeply about other things too. And she was always much worse at suppressing her wants and needs than people gave her credit for.
Right now, for example — she was muttering profanities under her breath as her morning routine was constantly interrupted by two other women she normally enjoyed the company of.

It was hard to enjoy anything at the moment, though. And it certainly didn’t help that they kept talking about things like love and sex when such concepts had been all but stripped from Wakana’s life as of late.
And yes, she may have still shared a bed with she who ushered in this sudden apocalypse, but it felt more like it was made of nails than whatever it is beds are normally made of.
No late night talks or sporadic groping sessions when one would wake up before the other. No facing one another before drifting off to sleep.
Just a bed that fits two — wide enough so they never have to touch outside of their dreams.
: So you’re just...sending him nudes now? Out of nowhere? For no reason?
: I figured it would be best if I just confessed that to you now as opposed to them being leaked online and you finding out the way my parents did the first time that happened to me.
: Your parents...saw your nudes?
: And I saw my daughter’s. Then, one day, Rin will see her daughter’s. And the cycle will go on and on until there are no daughters left to send nudes to anyone.
: And for this reason, I ask that you forgive me. I promise it’s only until someone other than Akira is willing to have sex with me.
: Must this really be discussed here of all places? I have tests to finish grading and you’re about to disrupt the whole process by causing me to spill my breakfast all over them.
: Funny story, actually. It’s that exact thing that ultimately led to me getting boned in the first place. That never would’ve happened at all if Imani didn’t throw up.
: So it’s my fault you slept with Senpai. Got it.
: Just out of curiosity, though, was it my fault it happened the following morning too?
: Never would have happened if you didn’t leave to buy us all water.
: So what I’m hearing is I just need to supervise both you and Senpai at all times and that this is going to keep happening if I just leave you two alone.
: Woah, weird. That’s exactly what Rie’s mom said to me when we first started dating. And it’s just as true now as it was back then.
: Again! Why must you do this here?! I am clearly busy!
: Why must you do this here? You have your own office, girl. Why you gotta be encroaching on mine?
: I wish I had an office. Or even a closet. I normally just hang out near the ropes since that’s all Akira showed me during orientation.
: This is not your office either, Imani. It’s Arakawa’s. And until you have the balls to admit to the front office that he isn’t ever showing up again, it’s going to stay that way.
: I don’t want to rat Senpai out, though! If you want his office so much, you do it.
: Do you think they’ll give me the office if I do it? Oh! Do teachers work like shogun? Will ousting Akira create a succession crisis where we all have to fight over his office? That sounds fun!
: All I’m saying is that I would like some peace and quiet...and that the two of you are more than welcome to use my office if you want to keep talking about fucking the shogun.
: I don’t think we should refer to Senpai as “the shogun.” The last thing he needs is more fodder for his power-dynamic kink and I’m pretty sure that’d do it.
: As someone who has only had fully conscious sex with him one time, I did not know about this kink. What other secrets do you know that I definitely won’t take advantage of?
: Just borrow the school uniform I bought and find out for yourself.
: I don’t need to. I stole one of Rin’s when I wanted to feel young again and it fits me surprisingly well.
: Well, that definitely isn’t foreshadowing a future sex scene or anything.
: Hey! Maybe we can both wear uniforms the next time we have a threesome with Akira! That sounds fun! We can even buy one for him and then we can all be young again!
: I’m still in my twenties. Don’t lump me in with you guys yet.
: Sorry. I just haven’t done anything sexual with a kouhai since high school.
: I’m your senpai technically. I worked here way before you.
: Oh, whoops. That doesn’t change much, though. I haven’t done anything sexual with a senpai since high school either.
: For the love of fucking god/God/GOD, if you’re going to stand there and ruin my morning, could you at least have the courtesy to talk about something else?!
: Because, as you may have heard, my love-life is in fucking shambles and the last thing I need is to hear about how much sex the two of you are having while I am having none!
: Wait, none? But you guys are still living together, aren’t you? I thought the whole proposal thing was like a...momentary hiccup. Like the last time you guys fought.
: Yeah, hold on. You’re not breaking up just because Osako wants kids, are you? Because you might want them yourself one day, Wakana. You just don’t know it yet. That’s how I was when-
: I don’t care how you were and I’m not interested in talking about this right now! We’re at fucking school! It’s entirely inappropriate!
: You literally have a pair of handcuffs in your desk.
: Why were you going through my desk?!
: I needed a stapler. How was I supposed to know I was going to wind up encountering a treasure trove of sex toys?
: Assuming Wakana isn't actually just an undercover cop, you mean. You can never be too sure of that. I know from experience.
: Also, you need a new pair of handcuffs. I may have taken those ones. And they may or may not be in the desk you’re sitting at right now. Don’t look.
: I’ll fuck you if you want, Wakana. That’s what friends are for, yeah?
: No, Rika. I don’t think that’s what friends are for. Nor do I think Wakana wants to have sex with you when she probably just wants to fix stuff with Osako.
: There is no fixing this, Imani. I can’t give her what she needs and I have no intention of making her wait around on the off-chance that I suddenly and completely change.
: Which is why I humbly ask that the two of you stop talking about this. Because I am having an extremely tough time right now and there is nothing that can make it any better but time itself.
: Hey, maybe you should try sleeping with Akira? That guy’s a dick-wizard. Maybe he can make you feel better?
: “Dick wizard” probably isn’t the term I’d use, but I will absolutely admit that he can make pretty much any worry go away for a good thirty-to-sixty minutes at a time.
: I think that time only goes up once you start involving more girls too because me and Imani took him on for at least three hours. Go team.
: Jesus fucking Christ! Do you two even hear yourselves right now?! You’re speaking of him like he’s some kind of fucking toy!
: I’m not going to sleep with him just to make myself feel better! And neither should you if that’s what you’ve been doing!
: Hey, as a reminder, I’m kind of in love with the guy. So maybe don’t lump me in with Rika here.
: I don’t think Akira’s a toy, Wakana. I’m just saying that sleeping with him might make you feel a little better and that he definitely wouldn’t say no to you.
: I don’t think that’s much better, Rika.
: It’s not! That’s basically the same fucking thing!
: Oh.
: Why?
: What do you mean “why?!” It’s still using him! And after all he’s been through in life, that’s the last thing we should be doing!
: I mean...is it really using him if you like him, though? Because you definitely do, don’t you?
: What? No I don’t. What are you talking about? He’s just a friend.
: I called it the first time I saw you two together, didn’t I? There’s some crazy sexual tension there.
: There’s no tension there at all! Imani, tell her.
: Without beating around the bush, I consider you my greatest rival of all and often feel extremely inferior after seeing the two of you together. There’s tension, alright.
: There’s no tension! I was and still technically am in an extremely dedicated and loyal relationship until it’s otherwise stated!
: I rest my case. Imani watches Akira like a hawk. If anyone’s going to know about sexual tension relating to him, it’s her.
: Wakana, I’m not questioning your loyalty or dedication. I don’t think you’d ever, like...cheat on Osako or anything.
: But you’re seriously not going to pretend you’ve never even fantasized about Senpai, are you?
: It’s not pretending! It’s the truth!
: Girl, your eyes were glued to him during our crazy beach sex night.
: They were not! You’re just making things up at this point!
: I wish. And maybe you just haven’t realized it yet, but there’s no way you see him as just a friend.
: Like, crazy horrible shit happened to me when I was younger and you didn’t obsess over it for months. But you did with Akira because there’s something more there.
: And ignoring how upset I still am over not being included in the crazy beach sex night, I don’t see what good it does to lie to yourself now, Wakana. It was just an idea. You don’t need to get mad.
: An idea predicated on me pulling the plug on the most important connection I have ever forged to find solace in the physical comfort of my closest confidant.
: It matters not how I look at him or what my fantasies may be. What matters is that you’d even suggest such a thing like it’s some sort of whim meant to be capitalized on.
: And to sit here and listen to the two of you speak about someone I care deeply for in this way only adds to the many frustrations I am currently feeling. Do you understand now?
: Yes.
: No.
: Hah...
: Having sex with Arakawa will not fix anything, Rika. In fact, sex as a whole can not fix anything. It’s just a bandage for a bullet hole.
: I don’t know. I feel kind of great now and all I really did was fuck him.
: That’s because you are a very special girl who likely doesn’t understand what she’s actually feeling yet.
: And again, Osako and I are not formally separated at the moment. We’re just...on the cusp of that inevitable fate. Again. In a more...serious way this time.
: What about crazy beach sex night part two then?
: What?
: And this time, Imani gets left out instead of me.
: What?
: I can not fathom how such a thing would be helpful right now when Osako and I don’t exactly want to sleep together given the uncertain nature of our existence as a couple and all.
: I know that. I’m saying I could hook up with Osako and you could hook up with Akira. Bingo bango, orgasms all around. We all get what we want.
: Not me! I don’t get anything! Why do I have to be the odd one out?!
: Imani, Osako is an experienced lesbian. You simply won’t be able to please her the way I can. And if we’re doing this for Wakana’s future, we need to seriously consider things like that.
: And how exactly will watching the love of my life get tongued down by a mutual friend benefit my future?
: You don’t have to watch. We’d be in separate rooms altogether. I got the idea from watching the Office last night.
: Why were you here last night?
: I think she means the TV show.
: I’m going to need an explanation.
: Season 8. Jim winds up sharing a hotel room with a temp named Cathy during a business trip while Pam was away.
: But Jim, despite the temptation, remains loyal to his wife and resists the seductress, further reinforcing his love for Pam and propelling them to the future!
: And this helps me how?
: Think about it. If you and Osako can both resist the temptation of being alone in a room with someone you’re attracted to for the night, it’ll reinforce your love for each other!
: Or one or both of you will fail and then realize it isn’t meant to be. It’s an extremely simple test, all things considered.
: It has its flaws. But it’s a step up from your last plan at least.
: Unfortunately, your “test” assumes that Osako is attracted to you and would be tempted by your seduction at all.
: Do not underestimate my seduction skills, Wakana. I could have any of you at any moment. The only reason I haven’t yet is because I’m polite.
: If she isn’t though, and you’re not attracted to Senpai either, don’t you think Rika’s plan might actually, and I can’t believe I’m saying this, work?
: No!
: Oh. Well, back to the drawing board then.
: Man. I thought I actually had something with that one.
: I am not asking for help as there is nothing the two of you can do about this. Besides giving me some space.

: So please, for the love of everything that is holy and Jim and Pam or whatever their names are, leave me alone and go use my office for your disgusting, objectifying conversations about Arakawa’s massive penis.
: Did we mention anything about his penis?
: I called him a dick wizard. But I’m pretty sure that was-
: OUT!
: Jeez, Wakana. You don’t have to yell. Rika’s already close to needing a hearing aid.
: Let me know if you change your mind about Operation: Cathy Simms! It might sound crazy, but drastic times call for drastic-
: Hello, HR? I’d like to file a complaint about two-
: AH! NO! ANYTHING BUT THEM! RUN, RIKA! RUN!
Another sunny morning, another reason to pull the curtain closed.
On more than just the light this time.
Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!
